credit: eyaler/hebrew_wordlists, CC-100 frequencies intersected with the hspell dictionary, inflected forms with attached prefixes included.
trainFilterWhy: No filter needed: this corpus is already intersected with hspell, so it is dictionary-clean as downloaded. Use the WITH-PREFIXES variant: Hebrew attaches ל ב ו ה ש מ כ directly to the word, so a base-form list misses most of what real text actually contains (לדוגמה is absent from the base list and rank 1987 with prefixes).
note: Where the scoring model comes from. Only scripts/build-model.mjs reads this, and only when you regenerate model.json. The runtime never fetches anything.
